domains.name: Wallet & Daily Rewards
domains.promise: Every member carries one per-guild play-money wallet — a spendable wallet balance plus a bank — that is lazily created exactly once under a guild-and-member advisory lock, topped up by steady /daily, /weekly, and /monthly rewards whose streak bonus rewards consistency, moved safely with /deposit, /withdraw, and a per-interaction-idempotent /pay, and mirrored into the member's quality-weighted XP via the quests bridge; every coin here is fake game currency with zero connection to the real-money commerce store, and commerce-held roles earn no game income.

controls.description: Master switch mapped to the economy_enabled guild_config key; when off, wallet and reward commands reply that the economy is not enabled on this server.
Play-money coins a brand-new wallet is seeded with, mapped to economy_starting_balance and applied when economy_get_or_create_wallet first creates the row.
Base play-money coins granted by /daily, mapped to economy_daily_amount; /weekly and /monthly scale from their own keys.
Percent bonus added per consecutive claim streak step, mapped to economy_streak_bonus_pct; rewards steady daily engagement without runaway payouts.
Percent tax skimmed from a /pay transfer before the receiver is credited, mapped to economy_pay_tax_pct; a conservative sink that defaults off.
Conservative cap on spendable wallet coins, mapped to economy_max_wallet; zero means uncapped and a /withdraw is clamped so the wallet never exceeds a non-zero cap.
Display name of the play-money currency, mapped to currency_name and shown across every wallet surface.
Emoji prefix shown beside coin amounts, mapped to currency_emoji.

defaults.rationale: The wallet is the backbone of the whole game economy and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience.
A zero start keeps early wins meaningful: members earn their first coins from /daily and activity rather than being handed a balance.
Five hundred coins is a satisfying quick early win that a casual member can claim in seconds every day.
A gentle five percent per streak step rewards long-term consistency without letting streaks dwarf the base reward.
Transfers are free by default so members can share coins freely; owners can add a sink deliberately.
Uncapped by default for a frictionless start; owners who want conservative stakes can set a real cap.
A neutral, brandable default the owner can rename to match their white-label voice.
A universally readable coin emoji that owners can swap for a custom brand emoji.

permissions.enforcement: Wallet commands respond for every member; earning, banking, and reward handlers only ever mutate the invoking member's own economy_wallets row, and /pay only credits the explicitly named receiver.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit wallet and reward settings on the dashboard economy page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Directly credit or debit another member's wallet outside a consented /pay transfer
permissions.enforcement: No command path writes another member's economy_wallets row except the receiver credit inside a /pay the sender themselves initiated; role income via /collect-income excludes commerce-held roles so commerce never funds the game wallet.

messages.trigger: A member successfully claims a /daily, /weekly, or /monthly reward
messages.surface: Channel embed replying to the reward command
messages.audience: The claiming member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: Daily reward claimed, {member-name} — plus {amount} coins landed in your wallet and your streak is now {streak-count} days.
Sent {amount} coins to {receiver-name}, {sender-name} — delivered to their wallet exactly once.

messages.trigger: A member tries to pay, deposit, or withdraw more coins than they hold
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: Not enough coins, {member-name} — you have {balance} but that move needs {needed}.

messages.trigger: A /pay debited the sender but the receiver credit failed
messages.defaultTemplate: That transfer bounced, {member-name} — your {amount} coins are already back in your wallet and nothing was lost.

messages.trigger: The wallet backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a wallet command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The vault is briefly jammed, {member-name} — give it a moment and try again.

messages.trigger: A reward credit keeps failing after the claim slot was taken
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: a {amount}-coin reward credit to {member-name} failed and is queued for automatic retry; nothing was double-credited and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has no economy_wallets row in this guild; the first wallet command lazily creates one under the guild-and-member advisory lock.
The wallet row exists with a spendable wallet balance and a bank; earning, transfer, and banking commands all work.
The member already claimed the current daily, weekly, or monthly slot; the atomic SET NX cooldown blocks a second claim until it expires.
A /pay debited the sender but the receiver credit failed; the sender was refunded so no coins were created or destroyed.
Economy disabled by configuration; wallet and reward commands explain the feature is off and no balances change.

transitions.trigger: The member runs their first wallet command
transitions.expectedEffect: economy_get_or_create_wallet creates exactly one wallet row seeded with economy_starting_balance under the guild-and-member advisory lock, even under concurrent first-touch.

transitions.trigger: The member runs /daily, /weekly, or /monthly with the cooldown clear
transitions.expectedEffect: economy_add_balance atomically credits the base reward plus streak bonus exactly once and the SET NX cooldown slot is claimed so no second credit is possible this cycle.
The next claim is allowed again with the streak continued within its window or reset outside it; no catch-up double credit occurs.

transitions.trigger: The member runs /pay to another member with sufficient balance
transitions.expectedEffect: The sender is debited and the receiver credited for one /pay interaction, applied exactly once even if the interaction is re-delivered.

transitions.trigger: The receiver credit fails after the sender was debited
transitions.expectedEffect: The sender is refunded the full amount so the play-money supply is unchanged and the member is told nothing was lost.
The sender's balance is restored exactly once; a retry of the transfer is the member's own next action, never an automatic double refund.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns economy_enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: Wallet and reward commands reply with the disabled explanation; all wallet, streak, and transaction rows are preserved untouched.
Balances, banks, and streaks resume exactly as they were with no coins gained or lost during the pause.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance for the receiver fails after the sender was debited via economy_subtract_balance
failures.expectedBehavior: The sender is refunded the exact debited amount once through the same play-money ledger, sees the refund confirmation, and no coins are created or destroyed; the receiver is never credited for the failed attempt.

failures.trigger: economy_add_balance fails while crediting a /daily, /weekly, or /monthly reward
failures.expectedBehavior: The reward credit retries automatically until it converges under the claim's idempotency, the member is never charged a full cooldown for an unpaid claim, and the reward is credited exactly once — never zero-paid-but-locked-out and never double-credited.

failures.trigger: Supabase is unreachable when a member runs a wallet command
failures.expectedBehavior: The command replies with the branded wallet-unavailable message, no coins move, and no half-created wallet row is left behind; after the dependency recovers a fresh command applies exactly once.
